verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents connecting GitHub as the mechanism for repo read/PR access (foreloop-docs-15) and a straightforward global CLI install plus `foreloop init` to wire a checkout (foreloop-docs-1, foreloop-docs-2), but the actual flow is multi-step (npm install, init, connect GitHub, run an agent locally) rather than a true one-click install, and no dedicated 'one-click' GitHub App/OAuth flow is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit one-click GitHub App installation flow, screenshots/docs of the connect-GitHub UX, and independent confirmation that setup is trivial in practice.
